label: Pet
description: Companion animals with scenario-strong texts (the trending whimsy cluster).

items.name: black-cat
items.text: a black cat with lantern-amber eyes, fur rim-lit into a soft halo, tail curled precisely over both front paws

items.name: ginger-cat-window
items.text: a ginger cat loafed on a sunny windowsill between plant pots, paws folded under, offering the garden a slow contented blink

items.name: golden-retriever
items.text: a golden retriever mid-shake, the spray whipping off in a backlit spiral that travels from nose to tail tip, ears airborne

items.name: border-collie
items.text: a border collie frozen in a working crouch, one paw lifted, giving the flock the unblinking stare shepherds call the eye

items.name: dachshund
items.text: a long-haired dachshund trotting big-dog confident, coat feathers swinging, nose leading the entire parade of itself

items.name: kitten-mischief
items.text: a kitten capsized in unraveling yarn, one hind foot in the air, pupils blown huge with play

items.name: husky-snow
items.text: a husky surfacing face-first from fresh powder, ice-blue eyes bright in a mask of caked snow

items.name: rabbit-clover
items.text: a lop-eared rabbit nose-down in clover, ears spilled forward, nose working faster than the eye can follow

items.name: parrot-shoulder
items.text: a parrot leaning into frame from a shoulder, head flipped fully upside down for attention, pupils pinning with excitement

items.name: pug-blanket
items.text: a pug swaddled to the chin in a waffle blanket, brow folded in ancient worry, resigned to life as a small disgruntled king

items.name: maine-coon
items.text: a maine coon overflowing the armchair it has claimed, lynx-tufted ears alert, tail long enough to wrap the entire armrest

items.name: hamster-cheeks
items.text: a hamster sitting bolt upright with cheek pouches loaded past its shoulders, one last sunflower seed still in hand

items.name: corgi-sploot
items.text: a corgi in a full sploot on cool tile, hind legs flat out behind, chin down, entirely satisfied with the decision

items.name: cockatiel-crest
items.text: a cockatiel with its crest sprung fully upright in surprise, round orange cheek patches like painted blush

items.name: guinea-pig-popcorn
items.text: a guinea pig mid-popcorn, all four feet off the ground in a vertical jump of pure excitement, a strand of hay still in its mouth

items.name: betta-flare
items.text: a betta fish flaring at its own reflection, gill covers spread into a dark ruff, halfmoon fins unfurled into backlit silk banners

items.name: donkey
items.text: a donkey with a broad grey muzzle and enormous ears turned independently, standing patiently in the shade of a wall
items.text_short: grey-muzzled donkey with independently turning ears

items.name: goat
items.text: a goat on a wall it should not be on, rectangular pupils, a beard full of hay and no intention of coming down
items.text_short: goat up a wall with rectangular pupils
